capabilities: annotate selected Markdown and PDF text with comments and highlights
review, search, resolve, and reopen annotations in a sidebar
display margin cards beside annotated Markdown text
export all annotations to Markdown files
recover annotation anchors after source edits
extras: PDF integration relies on Obsidian's internal PDF viewer DOM, so Obsidian updates may require plugin compatibility fixes; not yet in the community plugin directory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach highlights and margin comments to selected text in Markdown notes or PDFs without modifying the source files.
summary: Annotation plugin that lets you highlight and comment on Markdown and PDF passages, storing notes in a sidebar and as separate Markdown files.
